patterns.evidence: Late-evening hyperglycemia 180-220 mg/dL after high-fat lunches: D7 22:30 G=220, D5 22:30 G=215, D2 22:00 G=210, D10 22:45 G=210. Pizza, lasagna, and fatty meals causing delayed glucose elevation 6-10 hours post-meal.

patterns.name: Dawn Phenomenon
patterns.evidence: Fasting hyperglycemia 135-165 mg/dL: D7 07:00 G=165, D3 06:30 G=162, D9 07:45 G=158, D5 07:30 G=145. Variable but often elevated despite high evening readings, suggesting insufficient overnight basal coverage.
